camel_example: aliyun pvtz SetProxyPattern --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneId df2d03865266bd9842306db586d30000 --ProxyPattern ZONE
description_en: Sets the recursive resolution proxy for subdomains
description_zh: 调用SetProxyPattern设置子域名递归解析代理
kebab_example: aliyun pvtz set-proxy-pattern --zone-id df2d03865266bd9842306db586d30000 --proxy-pattern ZONE --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetProxyPattern

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the zone
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The proxy mode for recursive resolution of subdomains. Valid values:

ZONE: Disables the proxy. If a subdomain does not exist, an NXDOMAIN response is returned.

RECORD: Enables the proxy. If a subdomain does not exist, the system queries the forwarding and recursion modules and returns the final result
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启子域名递归代理。取值：
ZONE: 关闭（当解析本域名下不存在的子域名时，直接返回NXDOMAIN，表示子域名不存在）
RECORD: 开启（当解析本域名下不存在的子域名时，会依次查询“转发”和“递归”模块，并以最终查询到的解析结果来应答解析请求）
parameters.name: proxy_pattern

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request. It can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
